ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low ratio of high-intensity pixels (~5-10%) concentrated at distal tips and surface scratches against a dominant low-intensity (black/dark gray) field across the primary surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Overall convex sweep on the trailing edge of both lobes, transitioning to sharp lateral tapers at the tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple distinct white/light-gray linear pixel disruptions visible on the inner-left and mid-right lobes, oriented in various non-parallel diagonal axes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle encrustations on the distal tips and lateral margins of both lobes, appearing as high-contrast, three-dimensional pixel clusters.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant disruption of the natural trailing edge silhouette at the distal tips due to heavy biological growth protruding beyond the fluke's dermal boundary.
